official_definition: Banish a card from the opposing decktop. For each 4 cost this Spirit has, this effect banishes +1 card. Also, this Spirit's symbol is fixed as zero.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Wave Crush] or [Wave Crush: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Wave Crush]", "give [Wave Crush]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Banishes cards from opposing decktop to Removed Zone.
